XI." sits between two paragraphs. Notes in the right margin: one note beside the first lines of the second paragraph, two more lower down. Below the text: catchword "onibus" at right and signature "E" at left.

main_text.p: exprimantur: & rigidus nimis esset juramenti interpres, qui istarum aliquam exclusum iret. Sed siquis exceptiones admiserit magis dubias, & non a verbis juramenti solum sed & ab omni recta ratione alienas, nec jure communi & confensu populorum approbatas: nae is autem temerario fines Juramenti a Deo praestitutos loco moverit, & omni periuriorum generi latam portam aperuerit. Mancat[?] ergo secunda haec nostra hypothecis, de stricta juramenti interpretatione.
main_text.head: SECT. XI.
main_text.p: Cujus, ut & superioris de juramenti implicitate, propterea fusiorem istius tractationem, (etsi plurima alia me-ditanti[?] mihi in mentem venerunt, scitu non indigna, quae tamen brevitatis cau-sa[?] praetermittenda judicavi:) tum quod[?] rerum istarum clarior explicatio Lysandri dictum; apud Plut. in apophth. ipsa[?] est mihi his dissolutissimis maximè admodum necessaria, in temporibus admodum viri passim ludunt juramentis, Idem tamen lib. de fort. tum quod utrius-que hypothecteos permagnus erit usus, his quae Deo volente futuris prælecti-onibus Alex. id tribuit Dionysio tyranno.

page.notes: The left edge of the scan clips the first letters of many lines; those letters are marked [?] where they are inferred. The asterisk note ("Lysandri dictum") and the superscript before "pueri astragalis" are not clearly linked in the scan, so the note links were placed by position. The word "Mancat" is read as printed. The word "astragalis" follows a superscript mark. The text "pueri astragalis" is in the text column, not in the margin; it has been transcribed as part of the paragraph, but the hyphenated line break "prælecti-onibus" is at the end of the line and the paragraph may continue on the next page.
